ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB \parallel CD \parallel EF$, which intersect lines $l_1, l_2$ at points $A, D, F$ and $B, C, E$ respectively. If $\frac{AD}{DF} = \frac{2}{3}$ and $BE=20$, what is the length of segment $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB\parallel CD\parallel EF$,\\
it follows that $\frac{BC}{CE}=\frac{AD}{DF}=\frac{2}{3}$,\\
thus $CE=\frac{3}{2}BC$,\\
Given $BC+CE=BE=20$,\\
we have $\frac{3}{2}BC+BC=20$,\\
solving this gives $BC=\boxed{8}$.
